title.purpose: Card, step, team and article h3; buttons share the face and weight.

label.purpose: Card categories, project field names, footer heads, solution indices.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: State transitions, pops, rise-in reveals, card lift.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Nodes and the pattern tile appear.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: translateY(24-28px) + opacity 0 to none, 0.8-0.9s ease-out-quart, 90ms stagger
motion.purpose: Content reveals on load and scroll.

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: linear infinite: ticker 70s, pattern band 28s, CTA drift 30s alternate
motion.purpose: Ambient movement of crests and the pattern strip; pauses on hover/focus for the ticker.

motion.name: scroll-thread
motion.value: transform: scaleX/scaleY(var(--p)) driven by scroll progress
motion.purpose: Methodology thread fill and lit steps.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: durations 0.01ms; marquees and pulses off
motion.purpose: Every animation resolves instantly or stops.

components.name: Methodology Thread
components.description: Signature: dashed thread through ringed step markers; fill scales with scroll (--p) and lit steps tint to their hue.
components.css: .ds-steps { position: relative; } .ds-steps ol { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 32px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-steps li { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 18px; font: 700 17px/1.3 Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #153A62; } .ds-steps li span { width: 64px; height: 64px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 2px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; font: 800 20px Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 360ms cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1); } .ds-steps li.lit span { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 22%, #fff); } .ds-thread { position: absolute; top: 31px; left: 12.5%; right: 12.5%; border-top: 2px dashed #B9CCDD; } .ds-thread-fill { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: -2px; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ED8C32, #2679AD 38%, #F02A89 70%, #90D518); transform: scaleX(var(--p)); transform-origin: left center; }

narrative.overview:
Education is drawn as a network of threads: people, municipalities and steps of the work joined by thin blue lines that end in colored nodes. The world is calm and institutional at rest (light #F4F7FA and white fields, deep navy bands) and comes alive through motion that draws, pops and rises, never through decoration piled on the page.

The brand's saturated geometric pattern strip (`public/pattern-strip.png`, used as-is) is the only loud material. It appears as a small floating tile beside the hero photo, a moving marquee band under the navy section, and the drifting side column of the closing CTA. Everything else stays quiet so the pattern and the orange actions read.

Density is generous: wide section padding, large rounded media, soft navy-tinted shadows, pill buttons. Shapes are friendly and rounded, never sharp.
keyCharacteristics: Light fields alternate with deep navy bands; orange is reserved for actions.
Thin blue threads with colored nodes are the reusable signature.
The pattern strip is the brand motif, shown in bands and tiles, never redrawn.
Generous radii (20-28px) on media and cards, pills on every button and tag.
Shadows are soft and navy-tinted, used for lift, not outline.

rules.name: The Orange Acts Rule
rules.body: Orange fills mean "do something": buttons, focus, the current nav item. It is not a background or a decorative fill. Orange text on light grounds uses orange-ink.

rules.name: The Pattern Hues Stay On Threads Rule
rules.body: Magenta, lime and the other pattern hues appear only as nodes, rings, marker bars and the thread gradient, never as surfaces, buttons or text.

rules.name: The Manrope Speaks, Inter Explains Rule
rules.body: Headings, buttons, nav and labels are Manrope; anything read as a paragraph is Inter. Headlines use `text-wrap: balance`, paragraphs `pretty`.

rules.name: The Navy Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted with navy rgb(21,58,98), never black, and stays diffuse.

dos: Do keep orange for actions and focus; use orange-ink for orange text on light grounds.
Do connect things with thin blue threads and colored nodes when a surface shows relationships or sequence.
Do use the pattern strip image as-is for bands, tiles and columns.
Do tint every shadow navy and keep it soft and layered.
Do animate with draw, pop, rise-in (24-28px, 0.8-0.9s, ease-out-quart) and slow marquees; stagger by about 90ms.
Do honor reduced motion: marquees and pulses stop, reveals and draws resolve instantly.
donts: Don't redraw or recolor the logo or the pattern strip.
Don't use pattern hues (magenta, lime, purple, cyan, amber) as surfaces, buttons or text.
Don't use black, hard or offset shadows.
Don't use square corners on buttons, cards or media.
